title: Execute the vsdd half of the core removal: drop the mdatron-core library seam — in-crate schema shim, conformance tests ride the mdatron binary (the #739 workspace marker; mdatron #81 collapsed the workspace upstream)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Executed in 74b01866: mdatron-core left every manifest (workspace, vsdd-core, vsdd). schema_check.rs is the in-crate schema-pair shim — jsonschema 0.18, draft 2020-12, the same engine and draft the mdatron binary runs, with value-free violation messages; the registry loader's one call site swapped imports with diagnostic shapes unchanged. schema_validation tests ride the shim plus vsdd's own frontmatter splitter; cross_references tests drive the mdatron BINARY's verify --json over their temp trees, loud on absence per the preflight's substrate requirement. Upstream context: mdatron #81 collapsed its workspace (single binary-first crate, lib target carries no API-stability promise) — the #739 workspace marker's migration, both halves now real. Also noted upstream and relevant to our raise watches: mdatron landed BOM/CRLF fence tolerance with a shared fence-edge conformance corpus (their #78) and config file_globs jurisdiction (their #77).
